articles.summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, after winning the China Masters BWF Super 750 title, expressed boosted confidence for the upcoming Asian Games. Their coach noted the win vindicated faith in their recovery from injury, giving them momentum to "go all guns blazing."

articles.headline: Gen Next sets pace: Women fast bowlers eye India selection
articles.summary: Four young women fast bowlers—Akshita Bhagat, Palak Singh, Rohita Chowdry, and Joshna Angel—selected from a 13,000-strong talent hunt, are training at the BCCI Centre of Excellence. They aim for India selection, learning tactics, accuracy, and fitness from top coaches.

articles.headline: Pathirage scripts history, wins Diamond League javelin title
articles.summary: Sri Lanka's Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage capped a sensational season by winning the men’s javelin throw title at the 2026 Diamond League final in Brussels with an 89.04m throw. He became the first Sri Lankan athlete to win the prestigious title, despite cold weather conditions.

articles.headline: Sindarov ready to test Carlsen in Global Chess League
articles.summary: The highly anticipated clash between Magnus Carlsen and Javokhir Sindarov in the Global Chess League (GCL) will happen on Monday. The rapid format contest offers Sindarov his best opportunity to narrow the gap against the overwhelming favorite Carlsen.

articles.headline: Arsenal edge past Chelsea, level at top of EPL
articles.summary: Arsenal passed their biggest test, beating Chelsea 2-1 to level with Manchester City at the top of the Premier League table. Kai Havertz equalized, and Martin Odegaard secured the decisive goal after Chelsea's early lead. Chelsea's first dropped points left them on six.

articles.headline: India junior men rally to hold Japan in hockey
articles.summary: The Indian junior men’s hockey team showed tremendous grit to rally and secure a 3-3 draw against Japan in their second Pool A match of the Junior Asia Cup in Moqi, China. Captain Anmol Ekka scored twice, and Ashu Maurya added one.

articles.headline: India women win big in AHF Junior Asia Cup
articles.summary: The Indian women’s hockey team consolidated its top position in the AHF Junior Asia Cup Elite Pool with a commanding 11-1 hammering of Malaysia. Seven different players scored against Malaysia, in their second pool-stage match in Moqi, China.

articles.headline: Indian golfer Sharma slips at Omega European Masters
articles.summary: Indian golfer Shubhankar Sharma endured a disastrous third round at the Omega European Masters, carding a four-over 74. After opening with impressive rounds of 64 and 68, Sharma slipped to tied-50th after a spate of bogeys and double bogeys.

articles.headline: Mansi Singh finishes runner-up at Indonesia Masters
articles.summary: Young Indian shuttler Mansi Singh produced an impressive show to finish runner-up at the Indonesia Masters Super 100 badminton tournament. The 21-year-old from Uttar Pradesh suffered a 16-21, 8-21 loss to China’s Xu Wen Jing in the women’s singles final.

articles.headline: Messi sets up goal in Inter Miami draw
articles.summary: Lionel Messi provided an assist in Inter Miami’s 2-2 draw with Atlanta United in Florida. This marked the Argentine’s first appearance since retiring from international duty, whipping in a corner that midfielder Casemiro headed past the goalkeeper.

articles.headline: Rising Star triumphs in KSHA State Level hockey tournament
articles.summary: Rising Star Hockey Club eased to a 4-1 win over Jain University in the KSHA State Level hockey tournament in Bengaluru. In another match, Bangalore United Hockey Club handed Leo’s Sports Club a 3-1 defeat.

articles.headline: Knight Crusader for main event at Hyderabad races
articles.summary: In-form Knight Crusader is fancied to win the Mahabubnagar Plate (Div-I) over 1200m, the main event of the races to be held in Hyderabad on Monday. The first race is scheduled to start at 2.10 pm.

articles.headline: Double delight for Karnataka in South Zone badminton
articles.summary: Karnataka’s men's and boys' teams claimed contrasting victories to clinch the South Zone inter-state badminton championship titles in Bengaluru. The men staged an impressive 3-2 comeback win over Telangana, while the boys cruised to a 2-0 victory against the same opponents.

articles.headline: Zidaan and Akshat triumph in National Karting Championship
articles.summary: City youngsters Zidaan Arshaan Anees and Akshat Misra triumphed in their respective classes at the FMSCI Indian National Karting Championship in Bengaluru. Hridaan Sanadhya from Pune topped the junior max category in the fifth round of the competition.

articles.headline: Noraiah wins feature at Pune races
articles.summary: The Dallas Todywalla-trained Noraiah, brilliantly ridden by Antony Raj, clinched The Southern Command Gold Trophy, the feature event at the Pune races on Sunday. Noraiah was the in-form horse and won by a good margin.

articles.headline: Bengaluru’s warmth sets it apart: British Diplomat Chandru Iyer
articles.summary: British Deputy High Commissioner Chandru Iyer reflects on his four-year tenure in Bengaluru, highlighting Karnataka's diversity, green spaces, and the city's unique blend of communities and sounds. He hopes to promote Karnataka's food, culture, and products in the UK.

articles.headline: Too pricey or priceless? Art, money and the joy of collecting
articles.summary: Art curator Srila Chatterjee discusses the economics of the art world, advising collectors against prioritizing investment over personal connection. She believes art should be enjoyed and accessible, extending beyond galleries to everyday life, emphasizing emotional connection over financial gain.

articles.headline: Kailash Kher celebrates love, opens doors for budding artistes
articles.summary: Kailash Kher is releasing a romantic track, 'Tham Ja,' under Kailasa Records, and launching Kailasa Advertising Private Limited. This initiative aims to support upcoming musicians by offering affordable services, studio access, and ensuring copyright and royalties remain with the artistes.

articles.headline: Nithya Menen: 'My confidence was once called arrogance, now appreciated'
articles.summary: Actor Nithya Menen returns to production with a dark comedy, prioritizing instinctive filmmaking and like-minded collaborators. She advocates for actors making choices based on good intentions rather than industry expectations, asserting her confidence is now appreciated, unlike in her younger days.

articles.headline: Arjun Rampal to star with Mohanlal in Malayalam film
articles.summary: Arjun Rampal is set to make his Malayalam debut with 'Operation Ganga,' an upcoming Mohanlal-starrer directed by Meppadiyan filmmaker Vishnu Mohan. The film is based on the evacuation of 23,000 medical students from war-torn Ukraine.

articles.headline: Reels, reel makers and zero civic sense: The Metro debate
articles.summary: The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) warned against "phone-glueing" stunts and disruptive reel-making that obstructs passengers. Commuters raise privacy concerns, while creators argue for using public spaces for "relatable" content, sparking a debate on urban etiquette and permissible filming in public transport.

articles.headline: The Lives of Others: Disaster tourism in the AI era
articles.summary: This opinion piece critiques how social media amplifies hyper-dramatic, AI-generated fabrications of disasters over authentic news, turning human agony into high-performing content. It questions if society has normalized consuming visceral destruction for entertainment, blurring the line between witnessing and consuming.

articles.headline: Mamitha Baiju joins Deepika, Alia with three ₹200 crore grossers
articles.summary: Actress Mamitha Baiju achieved a milestone by featuring in three ₹200 crore-plus grossers—Jana Historic Nayagan, Vishwanath, and Kudumba Unit—in a single calendar year. All three films were released within 23 days, cementing Mamitha’s breakout year at the box office.

articles.headline: Historic watchmaker Gallet returns after two centuries
articles.summary: Gallet, the Swiss watchmaker founded in 1826 and now owned by Breitling, is returning after disappearing from the scene in the early 1990s. It will introduce four collections and anniversary editions reviving historic designs, with new watches starting at $2,900.

articles.headline: Messi honoured with edible portrait in Argentina restaurant
articles.summary: A Buenos Aires restaurant cooked up a cheeky tribute to Lionel Messi, creating a milanesa shaped like his face. This edible homage was unveiled just a day after the football star announced his retirement from Argentina’s national team, turning a beloved dish into a portrait.

articles.headline: Natalie Portman welcomed third child with Tanguy Destable
articles.summary: Natalie Portman reportedly welcomed her third child, her first with partner Tanguy Destable, last month in Paris. The actor, already a mother of two, called the pregnancy a "privilege and a miracle," emphasizing she wanted to be "respectful" of those who struggle with fertility.

articles.headline: India's crude oil import price nears $100 per barrel
articles.summary: The price of India's crude oil basket rose to nearly $99.35 per barrel, driven by global supply concerns and regional conflicts. This marks a three-month high and threatens to increase domestic fuel prices and inflation. While state-run oil companies have kept retail prices steady, sustained high crude costs may force a recalibration of the government's energy subsidies and fiscal targets.

articles.headline: World map must depict J-K, Ladakh accurately
articles.summary: India has called on the United Nations to ensure that world maps accurately represent the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. The move follows a UN resolution on digital infrastructure that used inaccurate geographic representations. Indian officials emphasized that any misleading depiction of the country's sovereign borders is unacceptable and must be corrected.

articles.headline: Punjab objects to appointment of new Chief of HC
articles.summary: The Punjab government has passed a resolution opposing the appointment of Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra as the Chief Justice of the Punjab and Haryana High Court. The state cabinet claims the appointment was made without consulting the state government, violating constitutional procedures. The move has led to a jurisdictional standoff with the central government.

articles.headline: ‘ISRO’s role won’t diminish’: Agency allays concerns over privatisation
articles.summary: ISRO Chairman S. Somanath addressed concerns regarding the increasing participation of the private sector in India's space programs. He clarified that ISRO's role would not diminish but would shift toward advanced research, deep-space missions, and planetary exploration. Private entities are expected to handle routine launch vehicle and satellite manufacturing to scale operations.

articles.headline: India, China armies hold LAC talks in Arunachal
articles.summary: Commanders from the Indian and Chinese armies held high-level talks at the Wacha-Damai border meeting point in Arunachal Pradesh. The discussions focused on maintaining peace and tranquility along the Line of Actual Control (LAC). This was the first such meeting in the sector since talks in Beijing, aimed at de-escalating tensions and improving border management.

articles.headline: Sat-Chi soar to win China Masters title
articles.summary: Indian badminton stars Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty won the China Masters title by defeating China’s He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu. This victory marks their first title of the 2026 season and boosts their standing as they head into the Asian Games. The duo won in three games with a score of 21-11, 21-13, 21-17, showcasing dominant form.

articles.headline: Ex-CM demands 75% quota for Dalits, OBCs, minorities
articles.summary: Former Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah has called for an increase in reservations to 75% for Dalits, backward classes, and minorities. He argued that the current cap prevents equitable opportunities based on population size. He also urged the current state government to implement the caste survey report conducted during his previous tenure to ensure social justice.

articles.headline: Roadmap prepared for drugs-free India by 2029: Amit Shah
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced a comprehensive roadmap to make India drugs-free by 2029. The strategy includes a multi-pronged approach involving supply reduction, demand reduction, and harm reduction. Shah emphasized better coordination between central and state agencies to dismantle drug networks and curb the flow of narcotics through both land and sea borders.

articles.headline: Derivatives expiry may see return of old model
articles.summary: Sebi is considering reviving the volume-weighted average price (VWAP) or a hybrid model for derivative settlements on expiry days. This proposal aims to reduce price distortions in the closing session that impact the Nifty and Sensex. The regulator is reviewing feedback to improve price discovery for over 200 stocks, potentially reverting to the system used before August 2024.

articles.headline: SBI to hire 12K personnel, add 250 branches in FY27
articles.summary: State Bank of India (SBI) plans to hire 12,000 new employees and add 250 branches across India in the 2026-27 financial year. Chairman C.S. Setty stated that the expansion aims to strengthen the bank's digital and physical presence. The recruitment will include approximately 11,000 to 12,000 officers and clerical staff to support the bank's growth in the coming years.

articles.headline: India qualify for U20 Asian Cup after 20 yrs
articles.summary: The Indian U20 football team has qualified for the AFC U20 Asian Cup for the first time in 20 years. India finished as one of the best runners-up in their qualifying group after a hard-fought series of matches. This qualification is seen as a major milestone for the development of youth football in the country and an opportunity to compete against Asia's top teams.

articles.headline: PSU Insurers Eye `7,200-Crore Windfall from Long-held NSE Stakes
articles.summary: Five PSU insurers are set to book substantial gains from selling stakes in NSE's IPO. Their combined holdings are valued at approximately Rs 7,200 crore based on an Rs 1,800 per share valuation. The sale offers a major financial windfall for these firms.

articles.headline: 1st India, China corps commander meet in Arunachal
articles.summary: Corps commanders from the Indian Army and Chinese PLA commanding formations in eastern Arunachal Pradesh geared up for talks to sort out ongoing tensions along the Line of Actual Control. This marks the first-ever corps commander-level talks in the eastern sector.

articles.headline: Beverage Cos Step up Bottle Use Amid Shortage of Cans
articles.summary: Beverage companies are increasingly using glass and PET bottles due to a shortage and high cost of aluminium cans, impacted by the West Asia crisis. This shift is driven by demand for festive season sales and supply chain disruptions.

articles.headline: India Set to Pitch Draft Rules on Foreign Control for AIFs
articles.summary: India will push for draft rules on foreign control for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) at the BRICS meet. The aim is to counter AI monopolies and secure global compute infrastructure, while also exploring a new definition of foreign control.

articles.headline: Grey Market Premium for NSE Soars on IPO Nod
articles.summary: The grey market premium for NSE's IPO has surged to Rs 250-280 per share after Sebi's approval. This indicates strong investor interest, with the IPO expected to launch by the end of September.

articles.headline: Forces gun down 2 Kuki militants at Manipur camp
articles.summary: Two United Kuki National Army (UKNA) militants were killed and two wounded in a shootout with a joint Army-Assam Rifles team at a camp in Manipur’s Churachandpur district. UKNA is not a signatory to the Suspension of Operations agreement with Centre and Manipur govt.

articles.headline: Hemant’s trusted aide and JMM’s crisis man Sudivya dies at 56
articles.summary: Jharkhand minister Sudivya Kumar Sonu, a confidant of chief minister Hemant Soren and strategist, died of a cardiac arrest in Giridih early Sunday. The 56-year-old handled urban development, housing, tourism, art and culture, and sports and youth affairs departments. Jharkhand govt announced two days of state mourning.

articles.headline: Hindu monk gets bail in B'desh, but won't be freed
articles.summary: Bangladesh's high court granted bail to former Iskcon member Chinmoy Krishna Das Brahmachari in two cases of obstructing police duties and vandalism. However, he remains jailed due to other pending cases, including murder and sedition, filed in late 2024.

articles.headline: Iran claims strike on US ship in Hormuz, US military denies
articles.summary: Iran claimed to strike an unmanned US vessel trying to enter the Strait of Hormuz, a claim the US military dismissed as a "total lie." This follows recent US strikes on three Iranian oil tankers, intensifying conflict between the two nations.

articles.headline: Far-right party may lead German state govt for first time since WW-II
articles.summary: Germany's far-right AfD party surged to 44.5% in Saxony-Anhalt state elections, potentially leading a state government for the first time since World War Two. This marks a significant setback for Chancellor Friedrich Merz's coalition government, with AfD now Germany's most popular party nationally.

articles.headline: US govt renews Supreme Court bid to limit mail-in voting
articles.summary: The Trump administration renewed its appeal to the US Supreme Court to limit mail-in ballots ahead of November's congressional elections. This follows a federal judge's block on new restrictions, making the Supreme Court the likely decider on the politically charged issue.

articles.headline: Cos set to raise 7.2k cr via IPOs in busy week
articles.summary: The primary market anticipates a busy week with 16 IPOs (11 main board, 5 SME) aiming to raise Rs 7,200 crore. This serves as a precursor to expected mega IPOs from NSE (Rs 30,000 crore) and Jio Platforms (Rs 37,000 crore) later this month.
